rows.jyutping: jung6 zaau1 siu3 ge3 jyu5 hei3
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing or saying something in a mocking tone.

example.english: They asked derisively why we were working so hard.
example.traditional: 佢用嘲笑嘅語氣話我哋咁勤力做乜。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jung6 zaau1 siu3 ge3 jyu5 hei3 waa6 ngo5 dei6 gam3 kan4 lik6 zou6 mat1

rows.note: Use this when the derision is expressed as a cheeky, taunting remark or attitude.

example.english: Are you saying derisively that you’re the best again?
example.traditional: 你又串嘴咁話自己最叻呀？
example.jyutping: nei5 jau6 cyun3 zeoi2 gam3 waa6 zi6 gei2 zeoi3 lek1 aa3
